name: Fujichrome Velvia 100
source: Fuji Photo Film Co., Ltd., FUJICHROME Velvia 100 Professional [RVP100] Product Information Bulletin, Ref. No. AF3-202E (2005-02), page 8

notes.characteristic: Exposure daylight, process E-6/CR-56, Status A densitometry.
notes.sensitivity: Process E-6/CR-56, Status A densitometry, density 1.0 above D-min, sensitivity = 1/exposure (J/cm2).
notes.dye_density: Spectral diffuse density of each dye, exposure separated, process E-6/CR-56; normalized to a peak of 1.0, no viewing illuminant stated.

grain.note: Diffuse RMS granularity, read at a gross diffuse visual density of 1.0 using a 48-micrometre aperture.
